endpoints.desc: OpenAI-compatible models discovery endpoint. Returns list of installed models with context windows and metadata.

examples.title: cURL
examples.code: curl -X GET http://localhost:8000/v1/models

examples.title: Python (OpenAI Client)
examples.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url='http://localhost:8000/v1', api_key='sk-no-key-required')
models = client.models.list()
print(models)

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

    "repo_id": "unsloth/llama-3-8b",

endpoints.desc: Loads a downloaded model into VRAM/RAM for active inference.

params.desc: The local ID of the model.

params.desc: Number of layers to offload to GPU.

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id": "llama-3-8b-instruct", "gpu_layers": -1, "context_size": 8192}'

endpoints.desc: Directly reads and parses the raw binary GGUF header from disk without loading the model into RAM. Returns all metadata key-values and the tensor shape map.

params.name: model_id
params.desc: The vault model ID. Use URL-encoded form for IDs with special characters.

examples.title: cURL
examples.code: curl -X GET http://localhost:8000/v1/models/gemma4-e4b-gguf-q4_k_m/inspect_raw_header

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

model_id = 'gemma4-e4b-gguf-q4_k_m'
res = requests.get(f'http://localhost:8000/v1/models/{model_id}/inspect_raw_header')
data = res.json()

print('Architecture:', data['metadata_kv'].get('general.architecture'))
print('Tensor Count:', data['tensor_count'])
print('Tensors:', data['tensors_shape_map'][:5])
